capture.metadata_policy: branch and commit are captured as single-line sanitized git identifiers

contract.use: accept the captured token before renewal
contract.commit: reject the old token before mutation

verification.full_observation: latest successful run passed; no failure was observed in the current collection

baseline.scope: historical V2 starting-point fixture; not the current suite result

assertions: old token after renew raises LeaseError
logical run-store state remains unchanged at the stale-commit boundary
primary snapshot bytes and SHA-256 remain unchanged

artifact_integrity.generation_rule: For a reproducible artifact digest, serialize this JSON as UTF-8 canonical JSON with lexicographically sorted object keys and no insignificant whitespace, omit artifact_integrity.digest, then hash the resulting bytes.
